# PASTEABLE LINES NO TEST EXECUTES THROUGH onboarding.CompareTranscript
# (docs/SPEC-TOOLWORK.md §7 rule 7, PR #1637 at 34f3188c).
#
# Every `$ ` line in a fenced block of README.md, docs/USAGE.md,
# docs/nova-swarm-quickstart.md and docs/CLI.md's `### First run` sections, and every
# `example:` line of every `help` banner, is either executed by a test through the one
# comparator or listed here with the reason it is not.
#
# One entry per line, `<line>` TAB `<reason>`. The separator is a TAB and not the ` #'
# the other allowlists use, because these keys are lines a stranger pastes into a shell
# and one of them carries a shell comment of its own.
#
# THE LIST ONLY SHRINKS. TestUnexecutedExamplesOnlyShrink checks it in both directions:
# an unlisted pasteable line is red on the pull request that adds it, and an entry whose
# line has left the document -- or whose document a test now executes through the
# comparator -- is a stale entry and red too.
#
# Today: 118 lines, none executed. What each one DOES when pasted is not this rule's
# question; #1455 measured that and found 28 of 61 banner examples exiting 2.
